Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You have highlighted available capacity and a comprehensive product range; it sounds like sustained business across the complete kit would be valuable to you. We want to build on our relationship while simplifying purchasing for the whole kit. What meaningful bundle discount could you offer in return for a longer contractual commitment?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.88 a fair kit price. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.60. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Likewise, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the opportunity to consolidate this kit with us. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

We can offer EUR 5.35 per unit for the 24-month term, and we kindly ask you to share the competing quote you mentioned for our internal review. 

Specifically, our offer stands at a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You highlight both the contract commitment and kit consolidation—it sounds like predictable bundled business is what makes this opportunity valuable to you. We want a straightforward agreement that rewards that commitment with a meaningful bundle discount. How can you reflect the value of the complete kit business in your price, alongside the verified easing in your named labour cost driver?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. As calculated, your own current prices give EUR 5.95 per kit; our offer reflects a fair bundle discount for a multi-year single-source agreement. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 5.02 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

It is always a pleasure to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we greatly value our ongoing business relationship and your trust in our broad inventory and service. 

We have verified the labour cost index data you provided and have factored this slight easing into our calculation. While we value the predictability of this bundled business, our pricing must reflect our overall cost structure beyond a single metric. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

Therefore, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.22 per unit for the 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms. To confirm the details of our Angebot, we present a price of €5.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
